checks.name: Settings › Barkpark › Library switch: confirm sheet, switch under the hold, the completed notice with Restart, a fresh host on Paper authority; both Papers on the runtime, legacy note retained and shown without an editor
Rollback from the same screen: the completed notice, a fresh host on legacy authority, legacy writes stay refused, Papers stay
A crash after the journal reached replacing leaves the profile prepared with the journal at replacing; the failure is said on screen
Clean quit, relaunch with the start-time switch notice, Resume from it completes the same operation; a fresh host reads Paper
Life on Paper after the switch: a new note is a Paper (legacy creation refused), typed, found by its body, deleted, recovered after a restart and still in the library after another
The assistant on the switched profile: an owned worker reads and appends through the MCP server, the canvas presents the edit, Undo restores the blocks exactly
checks.model: scripted turns through the real API SDK; not a live model

limits: One host, one run. The interruption is a simulated crash injected into the main process at the journal rename to `replacing`; the quit and relaunch around it are real. Labels generated, not reviewed.
